overall_assessment: Section extraction works very well for UiA: the standard headings (Læringsutbytte, Innhold, Undervisnings- og læringsformer, Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen, Eksamen) map correctly, sub-headings stay inside learning_outcomes, arbeidskrav go to coursework_requirements and the 'Ingen' placeholder is dropped. All pre-pass flags (short, empty, leak->X) are false alarms; the only real defects are admission text in prerequisites and a little workload text in coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Opptakskravet til studiet er bestått bachelorgrad eller tilsvarende utdanning av minst 180 studiepoengs omfang
findings.description: Under the 'Forkunnskapskrav' heading UiA puts admission/study-place text (Utdanningsdirektoratet allocates places, application link, admission requirement, ranking, no conditional admission). This is admission text, not a prerequisite in the codebook sense, and it is copied into prerequisites (595 chars for ORG966-1) together with the real 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper'. ORG937-1 has a milder case where 'Forkunnskapskrav' is the formal degree/work-experience admission requirement.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading 'Forkunnskapskrav' maps wholesale to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R; no cleanup of admission sentences (opptak, rangeres, betinget opptak, udir.no URLs) in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or a UiA post_fn for sections) drop prerequisites paragraphs matching 'opptak|rangeres|studieplass|udir\.no|betinget' while keeping course-code lists and 'Det anbefales ...' sentences.

findings.description: In PSY914-G the line on expected workload sits after the requirement list under the 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen:' sub-heading and so lands in coursework_requirements, although it belongs to teaching_methods (workload is placed there in every other UiA plan).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page has the workload sentence after the vilkår block without its own heading; heading-level splitting attaches it to coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Low priority: in .clean_sections() move sentences matching '^Forventet arbeidsomfang|^Arbeidsomfang' from coursework_requirements to teaching_methods.
